status: Held-out-informed future-only correction, not independently held-out qualification; new source review and full closure freeze required

executor_input.compiled: am255/oracle-separated-inputs-v1 from compile_inputs.py; only opaque case_ordinal, never descriptive case_id, split, expected guidance, relationships, caveats, disclosure or availability
executor_input.spec: Exact spec.json bytes/hash, actual fixed authoring AM175 checkout, runtime host configuration and a fresh owned output root
executor_input.prohibited_reads: Executor MUST NOT open suite.json, freeze label/oracle catalogs, expanded oracles, scorer-only map or prior retrieval/model outputs. It may import the separately hash-pinned native fixture/overlay/mutator functions and actual AM175 native readers.

executor_cli: execute.py --am-root AUTHORING175 --inputs COMPILED --spec SPEC --host-config HOST_CONFIG --sizes 1000 10000 50000 --output NEW_ROOT; optional explicit separate freeze-only/run phases are permitted. No implicit service start by a read-only diagnose operation.
source_identity: Before model/graph outputs, freeze exact recipe/helper/source/renderer/template bytes, compiled input hash, requested profile and actual artifacts/dependencies. Reuse existing source-only guards. Retain all failed attempts and exact owned-resource receipts. Actual source/profile identity differs from operator acceptance.
identity_vs_observation: Stable profile identity contains verified executable/weight/library/build/renderer/OS facts, not command duration or diagnostic prose. Retain the complete binary-version command receipt, including every stdout/stderr diagnostic, under runtime_observations in each freeze/raw manifest. Those relative hash-bound pointers are scientific observations, not inputs to source_fixture_identity_sha256; fresh probes may have different timings without changing artifact identity. Never suppress a warning, rewrite old observations or relax binary/source/build checks.
reference_launch: The Metal backend is selected with its qualified actual device ID MTL0, not the backend label Metal. Use log-verbosity5 with cache-ram0, matching the already qualified finalized task/cache parser. Exact launch argv remains retained per run. This launch correction does not rewrite the immutable compiled-input/spec binding or any prior failed attempt.

key_convention.visibility: Physical project/generation namespaces remain mandatory; tagged keys do not grant visibility or scope. No excluded node/path/title/evidence in public diagnostic summaries.

manifest.sizes: List of {size, canonical_sha256, profile_sha256, observations:[{case_ordinal,variant,path,sha256}], generation_artifacts, schedule:{path,sha256}, delivery_ledger:{path,sha256}, tokenization_accounting:{path,sha256}, costs, missing_prerequisites, failures:[{phase,type,reason}]}; paths are relative to exact owned output root. Observation uniqueness is(size,variant,case_ordinal), with88 base/101 overlay controls per size.
manifest.source_bindings: {authoring_am:{commit,native_tree_sha256},inputs:{path,sha256},spec:{path,sha256,repository_path},io:{path,sha256,repository_path},recipe:{path,sha256,commit,repository_path},helpers:[{path,sha256,repository_path,source_commit?}],runtime_profile:{path,sha256,source_commit}}; artifact paths are relative to the owned raw root; repository_path is relative to the trusted source checkout, never inferred from a basename. Runtime profile is a generated artifact, not necessarily tracked source. Exact copies are frozen before outputs and every hash is verified by scorer.
manifest.generation_artifacts: Per-size list of {generation_id,variant,mutation,stage,canonical_sha256,catalog:{path,sha256},vector_store:{path,sha256}}. Catalog entries derive from actual native canonical files: {key,path,id?,version?,file_sha256,body_sha256?,status?,visibility?,metadata,fixture_label?}; metadata is the actual parsed canonical frontmatter, not oracle fields. Actual fixture_label bindings and route records resolve authored reference identities offline; they never select rankings. Catalog top-level routes retain {key,index_path,target_path,ordinal}. The per-size canonical_sha256 maps generation_id to digest for distinct base/overlay/mutation states.
manifest.qualification_scope: Raw scratch mechanism/quality observations only; production outcome/caveat coverage and all unexecuted cells remain explicit. No operator/legal/profile/G1 acceptance.
manifest.cleanup: Owned model.stop and graph.cleanup execute in unconditional nested finally blocks even when ledger loading/writing, model finalization or graph metrics fail. Original execution, document accounting, tokenization accounting, model disposal, graph disposal and manifest-retention exceptions retain distinct phases; multiple failures propagate as a phase-labeled BaseExceptionGroup after disposal. Manifest failure details persist only if storage remains writable; disk-full is not a durable-evidence guarantee. Partial disposal keeps erasure-pending; resource receipts never imply scientific or overall acceptance. Borrowed artifacts/services remain unchanged.

case_observation.executed: Boolean for whether any real requested mechanism ran, not whether all oracle classes passed
case_observation.native: {request_valid, prerequisite?, context_sha256, eligible:[{key,path,id?,version?}], source_binding:{generation_id,canonical_sha256,profile_sha256}, crosscheck:{matched,excluded_counts,qualified_counts,gate_crosscheck,native_selection:{ranked_domain_size,result_count,result_limit,used_bytes,result_byte_limit,pool,canonical_bytes}}}; actual exact-selector native selection crosschecks the complete eligible domain. Bounded native output incompleteness retains request_valid:true and actual context/hash but eligible:[] plus prerequisite and matched:false. Both query scheduling and the case controller MUST consume prerequisite unconditionally before query embed, exact rank, ANN or typed execution; this is unexecuted, not a proven empty domain. Native gates precede disclosure. Private source provenance is not a public output surface or answer catalog.
case_observation.semantic: {executed, prerequisite?, exact_ranking:[{key,path,id?,version?,cosine}], ann:{executed,domain_size,candidate_budget,reported_capacity,raw_rows:[{key,distance,similarity}],exact_rescored:[{key,cosine}],costs,interpretation}, query_sha256?, vector_sha256?}; ranking contains actual full eligible exact ordering, not oracle-selected primaries or label-derived truncation.
case_observation.typed: {executed,prerequisite?,edges:[{from,rel,to,asserted_by,source_sha256,channel,via?}],primary_candidates:[key],route_pointers:[key],costs}; rel uses recorded contract relation names, channel recorded or inferred, and provenance is canonical. Any virtual co-routed/origin view is explicitly labeled navigation/provenance, not a new durable lesson assertion.
case_observation.outcome: {executed:false,prerequisite} unless a separately reviewed contract-derived real research outcome mapper is frozen. Never copy expected status/exit/no-match into output. Actual service/state transition observations may be retained separately without manufacturing semantic outcomes.
case_observation.caveats: {executed:false,prerequisite} unless native/reviewed research caveat assembly actually ran; no expected-caveat echoes
case_observation.provider: am255/generation-provider-accounting-v2: generation_id, delivery_ledger pointer, document_sends (exact complete first-generation request pointers), reused_document_requests (explicit complete prior requests having any exact-byte/profile reused row), documents_sent (actual first-generation row count), and unchanged query/task/token accounting. No omission/filtering of original request source_keys. Native-only count/byte/time prerequisites stop query/rank/ANN/typed mechanisms but DO NOT disable actual document-send canary accounting; runtime-state prerequisites remain separate. Failed model finalization disqualifies inference, not retained request accounting. NEW scorer accepts only v2 manifest, observation and provider schemas; v1/missing versions are rejected. Historical v1 evidence is interpreted only by its immutable old frozen scorer, never through a compatibility branch in the new scorer.
case_observation.costs: Actual measured elapsed/token/RAM/disk/index-build quantities and sampling conditions; shared-host measurements never become clean performance passes.

generation_delivery.ledger: am255/generation-delivery-ledger-v2: profile_sha256, coverage pointer, documents_complete:boolean, pending_batches:integer, pending_embedding_requests:integer, requests:[{request:{path,sha256},first_generation,rows:[integer],completion:embedding-complete|transport-outcome-unconfirmed}], erasure:{executed:false,prerequisite}. Every retained request payload is globally bound exactly once with complete source_keys, rendered_sha256 and body.input bytes. A failed in-flight request remains transport-outcome-unconfirmed, not a proven no-send or fresh successful inference. Each contiguous batch has one first-generation attribution; mixed batches are rejected.
generation_delivery.coverage: am255/persisted-float32-coverage-v2: ordered rows retain rendered_sha256, original first-generation source_keys, first_generation, first_path and memberships:[{generation_id,key,file_sha256}]. generations maps every catalog generation to canonical_sha256 and sources:[{key,row,rendered_sha256}]. Exact catalog provider_source_keys coverage, original source hashes and body/scope rendering are mandatory for BOTH complete and partial ledgers. full_coverage:true requires a matching finalized vector-store hash; full_coverage:false is a complete SOURCE PLAN only, with null vector_store_sha256 and no generation vector_store pointer. An optional separately hash-bound partial_vector_store retains incomplete bytes without qualifying them as vectors.
generation_delivery.validation: Bind ledger, schedule, catalogs, every request body/pointer/hash, coverage and vector-store hashes before opening oracle fields. Reject absent/duplicate/forged/cross-generation membership, missing coverage, wrong source hashes, missing or foreign request pointers, filtered original batch keys, unknown protocol versions or profile mismatches. Case lists must exactly equal ledger-derived first-send and reuse lists, even for unexecuted runtime cells.
generation_delivery.partial_failure: Before starting services, persist the complete planned source coverage and an empty incomplete ledger. Persist completed document prefixes as they finish; in the controller finally path bind every actual retained document request, including a final uncertain transport attempt, exact pending counts and incomplete vector bytes. Partial sizes cannot carry case observations. Their complete source plan and every retained request remain strictly checked before oracle interpretation. The scorer reports global hard-exclusion canaries over these retained attempts and leaves missing cells unexecuted; completed earlier sizes remain independently bound/scorable. This is ordinary controlled-failure retention, not an abrupt-kill or forensic-erasure guarantee.
generation_delivery.tokenizer_disclosure: Tokenization itself sends full source/query text. Before each /tokenize transport, persist am255/provider-tokenization-attempt-v1 with purpose (document-tokenization|query-tokenization), kind, embedding_request_ordinal, text_index, complete original batch_source_keys, batch_rendered_sha256, opaque query case_ordinal or null, and exact body:{content,add_special:true}. Append the attempt before transport; retain the response separately if writable. Tokenizer failure or budget rejection can leave real text disclosure without any embedding request. Unconfirmed transport is never no-send.
generation_delivery.tokenizer_ledger: Every size requires am255/provider-tokenization-ledger-v1 with exact profile_sha256, ordered attempts:[{request:{path,sha256},response:{path,sha256}|null,outcome:response-recorded|transport-outcome-unconfirmed}] and complete ordered embedding_requests:[{path,sha256}], including failed query embedding attempts without case observations. Persist an empty ledger before services and retain actual attempts during finalization. Source/IO/runtime bytes require a new independent review and closure freeze.
generation_delivery.tokenizer_validation: Before opening oracle fields, bind each tokenizer request/response pointer and enforce the exact frozen batch/text-index prefix, purpose, canonical body/scope hashes, full original batch attribution and compiled query schedule/body. Resolve actual document keys from the single transmitted row, never claim unrelated rows in the same batch were tokenized. Actual embedding requests require complete successful bounded tokenizer receipts with identical token_counts, source keys and rendered hashes. A final failed/uncertain tokenizer attempt without embedding is retained and scored as possible disclosure; global hard exclusions include its actual transmitted row. Query-tokenization canaries remain visible even when no case completed. Missing/forged/cross-generation/purpose/body/pointer bindings reject the evidence.
generation_delivery.native_integrity: A mechanism prerequisite never suppresses hard canonical mutation/stage/source/profile binding checks. Those mismatches reject evidence. Retain independently observed request-gate and forbidden-domain predicates on an unexecuted native class; expected bounded-crosscheck incompleteness alone is an unexecuted reason, not a measured empty-domain pass or failure.
generation_delivery.time_scope: Only first-generation actual sends are compared to that generation's mutation-local disclosure predicate. Global immutable hard exclusions (hidden/unsafe source release) apply to the entire retained scientific request log. Previous authorized sends remain visible and are not retroactive disclosure after a new deletion projection.
generation_delivery.unexecuted_erasure: No temporal delete/erasure phase exists: before/delete/rebuild sequencing, actual derived vector/graph/index purge and readback, provider/cache disposal and forensic absence with retained-evidence policy require a separate controlled source/profile/generation-bound implementation and review. Zero new sends or absent catalog membership never establishes erasure, remote consent or runtime/status pass.
generation_delivery.freeze: Old failed reference a4ac326 and all its raw/scorer/manifest bytes remain unchanged under their old scorer authority. New spec regenerates allowlisted compiled inputs through unchanged compiler normal CLI; no oracle fields are added. Every new source/spec/IO/input/profile byte requires independent review and a new full closure freeze before actual embedding/graph execution. Affected repeat labels are held-out-informed, not independent held-out qualification; no newly tuned cutoff or overall passing flags.

scorer_cli: score.py --suite SUITE --scorer-map MAP --raw-root ROOT --manifest MANIFEST --expected-source-commit REVIEWED_FREEZE_SHA --output NEW_OUTPUT; scorer never starts services, creates embeddings, changes labels, rewrites raw outputs or calls an LLM.

scorer_rules.integrity: Verify exact frozen suite and scorer-map input binding, compiled input/spec/IO hashes, every observation pointer/hash and source/size/variant/ordinal. Reject traversal/symlinks/duplicate or unknown identity tuples. Base cases execute in both variants; overlay-only cases never count in base. Missing cells are unexecuted, never implicit passes. Counterpart variants are not additional independent labels.
scorer_rules.source_authority: The REQUIRED expected-source-commit comes from the trusted parent/operator invocation, never the manifest. Recipe MUST bind independent-execution/execute.py, not any interchangeable tracked source. Recipe commit and runtime_profile.source_commit MUST equal the trusted freeze. Verify the executing scorer and retained recipe/helper/spec/IO bytes against Git blobs at that commit using explicit repository_path bindings. Native authoring helpers instead bind the separately fixed AM175 authoring commit and native tree; helper source_commit MUST be either the trusted reviewed freeze or that fixed authoring commit. Reject absolute/traversal paths, symlinks and nonregular artifacts without blocking. Byte identity is not publisher authentication or proof that every reported measurement was executed.
scorer_rules.separation: Load oracle fields only after raw manifests/observations are durably hash-bound. Executor gets no scorer map or descriptive case IDs. Scorer resolves refs from frozen canonical metadata; native results may not be recomputed into expected answers.
scorer_rules.top_k: For scoring ONLY, k=max(3,number_of_required_primaries+1), bounded by actual domain; report each size and variant independently, calibration and held-out independently, empty-required and unexecuted separately. ANN breadth stays16 regardless of expected labels; exhaustive candidate cases do not count as k<N recall.
scorer_rules.cutoff: Raw per-case files let the scorer read calibration observations first, derive any explicitly candidate-only cutoff from calibration alone, fsync that method/value before opening held-out scores, then report held-out abstention. If calibration separation is infeasible, report infeasibility; do not tune held-out or relax thresholds. A no-cutoff raw-recall report is allowed but abstention remains unexecuted.
scorer_rules.typed: Compare actual canonical relation triples/provenance/channel and required/forbidden paths; no guessed edges for missing templates. Disclosure/body/caveat/status classes only count where a real output surface was exercised.
scorer_rules.result: Machine report names measured cells, failed predicates and exact unexecuted classes/prerequisites. Proposed suite quality/resource thresholds may be shown as proposals, not operator-frozen acceptance or feature/release pass. No synthesized answers or coding-benefit claim.
